meta.title: Fenwick & Lowe — a one-page site
meta.description: An architecture practice on a single smooth-scrolling page: the menu is anchors, not pages, and every link glides to its section.
meta.author: jamiemarsland

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
// The definition rides INSIDE this blueprint, base64, and the boot calls
// the plugin's own gogh_site_def_boot() straight from gogh.php: no second
// fetch from PHP (Cloudflare's bot check refuses some server-side clients)
// and no demo-boot.php, which the public zip leaves out on purpose.
// One page, eight sections, a menu of anchors: the editor draws it all on
// the first load (?gogh-build=1), then sends you to the finished site.
wp_set_current_user( 1 );
try { wp_trash_post( 1 ); } catch ( \Throwable $e ) {}
$def = json_decode( base64_decode( '' ), true );
if ( is_array( $def ) && function_exists( 'gogh_site_def_boot' ) ) {
	try { gogh_site_def_boot( $def ); } catch ( \Throwable $e ) {}
}
